rationale.conceptual: The method is established DFT with charged defects, jellium compensation, and formation energy formula; implementation requires careful selection of lowest-energy configurations and correct handling of pseudopotentials and convergence, but no novel algorithm.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves ~10 distinct DFT relaxations (supercells, various dopants, divacancy configurations) with Quantum ESPRESSO, plus a post-processing step to compute formation energies and extract lattice parameters. This is a multi-stage dependency flow using an external tool, but not excessively long or fragile.
